en: <CLT=cltMIND>Hm? What's that over there...?

C'mon, what's the big deal?
I can't hold back any longer...

N-No... It's too soon...
I'm not ready for that...

I won't make things worse...
And you'll probably feel a lot better...

We can take this relationship to the next
level... Please.
...But Miu, we shouldn't.

It'll be fine...just come with me.
We'll do it together.

<CLT=cltMIND>Pulling on Keebo's arm, Miu made her
way to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab.

What was that...? I feel like I just saw
something I wasn't supposed to see.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should...check to see what's going on.
Just in case...
Ah, Keebo? What are you doing—
Wah!
Ah! S-Sorry! Did I startle you?

N-No, I'm the one who's sorry!
Really, it's nothing!
Hey, quit gettin' in the way!

Get out! Go stand over there, ya peepin'
Tom!
<CLT=cltMIND>What? I was just talking to Keebo...
<CLT=cltMIND>Well, I suppose Miu is always like this.

I'm sorry, I can't right now...
I'll just leave these objects with you.
Shuichi...there's something I have to tell you.

<CLT=cltMIND>Something she has to tell me?
What could it be?

In the last trial, I admitted there was a trick
to the water tank. But I didn't use it.

I did the Underwater Escape Act with magic.
That was magic.
Got it?
Y-Yeah...
<CLT=cltMIND>She's still not gonna let that go, huh?
But...I'm filled with regret.
Regret?

My shows are supposed to make people smile.
But...it was used for the exact opposite.

Plus...if I hadn't used all my magic doing
the Underwater Escape...

I could've instantly killed the piranhas
and saved Ryoma's body...
Himiko...

It seems like...as a mage...
I've still got a ways to go...

It seems like...as a mage...
I've still got a ways to go...
This is my magic, too...
Ah, no, I used an item on the statue—
It's my magic.
...Yeah, let's go with that.
My spirit was weak last night...

I meant it when I said that I was sick
of the killing game...

But I'm ashamed I even suggested that
we give up and stay here forever.

We're gonna escape this place, without
resorting to killing! We can't give up!
You're right. We can't give up.

With Himiko by my side, I'll fight to carry on
Kaede and Kirumi's wishes!

Oh, and I guess...Rantaro and Ryoma's
wishes too. Might as well...
...Might as well.

You should be grateful that I'm being nice
and including degenerate wishes at all!

We're gonna escape this place, without
resorting to killing! We can't give up!

With Himiko by my side, I'll fight to carry on
Kaede and Kirumi's wishes!

Yes! A dojo! No school is complete
without a dojo!
Now, let's gooooo!

...Oh, Shuichi, you can decline. I'd actually
prefer it, since you're a degenerate and all.

Ahhhh, damn it all!
This is gonna bug me!
Bug you? What is it?
Huh? Mind your own goddamn business!

Tch! If he keeps this up, he's just gonna
make it worse...!

How can he turn down a gorgeous genius
like me!
The polite thing to do would be to accept it...

<CLT=cltMIND>She's muttering about something...
It's probably best to not get involved.
Arrrrgh... I can't hold back any longer...

Just thinkin' about it...
Heh, heeheeheehee...

<CLT=cltMIND>She's muttering about something...
It's probably best to not get involved.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kirumi's final moments... I can't get the image
of her running for her life out of my head.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can still hear her...
Her scream of defiance.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps running isn't so bad...
Perhaps we aren't strong enough to face it.
<CLT=cltMIND>In order to live until the <CLT=cltSTRONG>end<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>It must be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Research Lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
And from the look of the building—

It's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Aikido Master<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s lab!
I'm sure of it!

Alright, let's go inside!
Don't be shy, Himiko! Ladies first!
Nyeeeh...what a paiiinnn...

<CLT=cltMIND>Pushing Himiko along, Tenko stepped
inside the building.
I suppose I should check inside too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't remember there being any
mysterious objects here. I'll look elsewhere.

<CLT=cltMIND>Careful not to make a sound,
I opened the door and peeked inside...
<CLT=cltMIND>I heard a strange sound...

<CLT=cltMIND>When I looked for the source of the sound,
my eyes were met with an unbelievable sight.

Man... You're really plugged up.
You're practically throbbing..
...Throbbing with dust and debris, that is.

Mm-mm... This is no good. No good at all.
You must feel so pent up...

I apologize... I've been neglecting my needs
ever since I got here...

Relax... I'll get it all out. Trust me, you'll
feel much better afterward...
Oh, um... Thank you?

Oh yeah, your chassis is firm...
*Really* firm. Like, damn...

Your body is seriously incredible!
I've...never seen one like this...

C-Careful... B-Be gentle...
That tickles...

This is amazing... Whoever put you together
definitely knew what they were doing...
Ahhhh... I feel...all tingly...

Y-You definitely know what you're doing, too.
If you keep this up, I just might—
WH-WHOAAAAA!

Mmmmmm... So that's the sound you make
when I touch that spot. Good to know...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I closed the door without a word.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu was just doing some maintenance
on Keebo's body. That's all it was.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Indeed. Nothing but that.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu is doing some maintenance
on Keebo's body.
<CLT=cltMIND>...And nothing else.

A...A building? What kinda technology
makes a building suddenly appear?

Haiyah! It's not just any building, it's a dojo!
So it doesn't matter how it appeared!

Like, I wouldn't care if a chef came by car or
train, as long as they made me good food!
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that really the same?

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item on the stone statue,
a building rose up...
<CLT=cltMIND>What kind of technology is this?
Hm...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a mysterious object, but I don't
think I can use any of the items on it...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Let me try a different object.
Hm...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is a mysterious object, but I don't
think I can use any of the items on it...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Let me try a different object.
